panels.title: API logs
panels.description: Every line the API writes: requests, questions, uploads and errors. It refreshes every 5 seconds; for a continuous stream open Explore and press Live

targets.expr: {service="api"} | json | line_format `{{ .level }} [{{ .context }}] {{ if eq .message_event "http_request" }}{{ .message_method }} {{ .message_path }} -> {{ .message_status }} ({{ .message_durationMs }} ms){{ else if .message_event }}{{ .message_event }}{{ if .message_status }} {{ .message_status }}{{ end }}{{ if .message_latencyMs }} ({{ .message_latencyMs }} ms){{ end }}{{ else }}{{ .message }}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Requests per minute by status
panels.description: Health checks are not logged. Status 2xx is success, 4xx a client error and 5xx a server error

panels.title: Average request time
panels.description: Includes the wait for the model, so a question takes seconds with the real provider

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Failed model calls, provider errors, unexpected exceptions and server errors

targets.expr: {service="api"} | json | level=~"warn|error|fatal" | line_format `{{ .level }} [{{ .context }}] {{ if eq .message_event "http_request" }}{{ .message_method }} {{ .message_path }} -> {{ .message_status }} ({{ .message_durationMs }} ms){{ else if .message_event }}{{ .message_event }}{{ if .message_status }} {{ .message_status }}{{ end }}{{ if .message_latencyMs }} ({{ .message_latencyMs }} ms){{ end }}{{ else }}{{ .message }}{{ end }}`
